name: saos
description: Soto Accounting Operating System — self-hosted business OS for Soto Accounting LLC + Hilo NFP

scripts.test: npm run check:prices && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.staging:up: docker compose -p saos-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml up -d
scripts.staging:down: docker compose -p saos-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml down
